en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4095 - In a narration from Ismail ibn Muslim, from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), from his forefathers (peace be upon them), from Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as), who said that the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:

"The back (of a riding animal) may be ridden if it is given as collateral (rahn), and the one who rides it is responsible for its expenses.
And the milk may be drunk if it is given as collateral, and the one who drinks the milk is responsible for its expenses."
